title: azt hiszem: I Think, I Believe

sections.title: Believing, not just opining
sections.content: You know *azt* *hiszem* ("I think, I believe") from stating opinions in earlier lessons. It is built from *hisz* ("to believe") in its definite form *hiszem*, plus *azt*, the accusative of *az* ("that") pointing forward to the idea that follows. You already use it with *hogy* (*Azt hiszem, hogy ...*); in everyday speech *hogy* is often dropped and the clause simply follows after a comma.

items.spanish: Azt hiszem, ez a jobb megoldás.
items.english: I think this is the better solution.

sections.content: *Azt* *hiszem*, *hogy*... and *Azt* *hiszem*, ... mean the same: *hogy* is optional. In a question, *Azt* *hiszed*, *hogy*...? normally keeps it.
